title: QSOL UFF v5.1.0: Defense-in-Depth Trust, Witness, Calibration, and Telemetry for Reproducible Astrophysics
description:
QSOL UFF v5.1.0 is an additive assurance release of the reproducible astrophysics and falsification laboratory. It retains the v5.0.0 galaxy/compact-object, UFF-SLFA, Sheridan Crucible, provenance, and assessment systems while adding a deliberately small defense-in-depth layer around evidence admission and observation.

The new layer comprises a QEC-inspired fail-closed computational boundary gate, a SPECTRAL-inspired pre-observation input-identity witness, a statistical-mechanics interpretation guardrail separating deterministic replay from null-ensemble calibration, and SONIFICATION-inspired receiver-neutral forensic telemetry.

Assurance boundary: REPLAY_VERIFIED != ENSEMBLE_CALIBRATED != PHYSICAL_TRUTH. Hashes, replay, commitments, and telemetry strengthen computational assurance; they do not establish physical ontology, historical analyst blindness, catalogue independence, null-model adequacy, or causal truth.

The release includes a formal technical report documenting the threat model, authority boundaries, regression hardening, assurance ladder, and archival requirements.
